text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, Anndee pellet, si on hulii Alla on ɗoftike Mo on rentike e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, O waɗanay on ko senndindiron goonga e meere hara ɗin jilɓanataa on, O heefana on bakkaatuuji mon O haforana on junuubi mon. Alla ko Jom-Ɓural mawngal, hino jeyaa e maggal, Aljanna mo O marani gomɗuɓe ɓen e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
